Party: Beneficial owner; property-owning entity; investor; fund
What it supplies or receives: Equity, objective, risk capital; distributions and property value
Main connection to the manager: Mandate, budgets, approvals, funding, reporting

Party: Asset manager; owner representative; family office
Main connection to the manager: Operating plan, exceptions, forecasts, transaction preparation

Party: Association/co-op board; committees; voting members
Decisions/rights it usually holds: Reserved votes, budgets, rules, capital decisions
Main connection to the manager: Meeting materials, approvals, enforcement, reserves, records

Party: Management-company principal; licensed broker where applicable
Main connection to the manager: Scope, economics, supervision, escalation, liability

Party: Regional/site/property manager
Decisions/rights it usually holds: Authority granted by mandate, policy, law
Main connection to the manager: Owns execution across people and systems

Party: Leasing/brokerage; marketing; reservations staff
Main connection to the manager: Availability, pricing, approved terms, qualification

Party: Bookkeeper; controller; treasury; payroll; CPA
What it supplies or receives: Accurate books, client funds, payments, filings
Main connection to the manager: Bill/receipt matching, cash availability, distributions, close

Party: Prospective occupant; applicant; tenant; resident; guest
What it supplies or receives: Demand, payment, information; receives use and service
Decisions/rights it usually holds: Application, agreement, notice, complaint, lawful remedies
Main connection to the manager: Inquiry through move-out and later disputes

Party: Roommates; household members; guarantor; emergency contact; representative
What it supplies or receives: Shared use, guarantee, consent, emergency support
Decisions/rights it usually holds: Rights differ from named payer or leaseholder
Main connection to the manager: Occupancy, access, changes, lawful disclosure

Party: Housing authority; subsidy administrator; tax-credit allocator; service coordinator
What it supplies or receives: Assistance, eligibility rules, monitoring, resident support
Decisions/rights it usually holds: Program approval and oversight within program
Main connection to the manager: Certification, assistance payment, inspection, transfer, reporting

Party: Maintenance employee; building engineer; cleaner; concierge; security
Main connection to the manager: Work, access, condition, safety, shift coverage

Party: Trade contractor; general contractor; subcontractor; supplier
Main connection to the manager: Scope, bid, dispatch, progress, change, completion, invoice

Party: Architect; engineer; surveyor; inspector; environmental specialist
Main connection to the manager: Design, safety, condition, permits, reserve studies

Party: Utility; telecom; waste; meter provider; district service
Main connection to the manager: Account transfer, interruption, repair, billing, capacity

Party: Bank; payment processor; card network; escrow provider
Main connection to the manager: Receipts, releases, reconciliations, fraud responses

Party: Lender; servicer; lender's inspector
Main connection to the manager: Reporting, reserve release, repairs, insurance, default

Party: Insurance broker; insurer; adjuster; restoration firm
Main connection to the manager: Risk changes, renewals, incident notice, mitigation, payment

Party: Lawyer; mediator; court; enforcement officer; receiver; trustee
Main connection to the manager: Notices, claims, possession, insolvency, transfer of authority

Party: Building/fire/health/environment/rental regulator; tax authority
Main connection to the manager: Registration, filings, inspections, correction, appeals

Party: Emergency responders; neighboring owners; adjacent occupants
Main connection to the manager: Hazards, access, common systems, incident communication

Party: PMS; CRM; access-control; accounting; screening; communications; AI vendors
Main connection to the manager: Data, actions, audit history, outages, export, switching

Party: Buyer; seller; developer; outgoing/incoming manager
Main connection to the manager: Diligence, assignments, opening balances, keys, unfinished obligations
